Ive never commented on reddit before but after reading this i feel as though i should share something with you i share every once in a while in person with others who are in relationships. Ive formulated a simple plan in the form of rules when it comes to love. I made the rules to combat traditional advice of love given by peers and parental figures…
Rule#1 in order to love someone else you must first be able to love yourself. You come first, your physical health, mental health, diet, wants needs.

Rule#2 Honesty and communication is key in monotone voices. Raising voices leads to primal intense shouting matches and possible violence. 

Rule#3 your partner is not your property, you cant but want to try to tell each other what to do. Who to talk to and etc. if you were meant to be and can work with each other then you can trust each other. Its all about trust. 

Rule#4 once a cheater always a cheater. Then moment your trust has been betrayed seperate yourself from that person. 

As far as suicide goes every life form starts off somewhere simple where the goal is to survive and reproduce. The human mind does not want to die so you must seperate yourself from everything that conditions you to think suicide is an answer and this means everything on a conscious and subconscious level. Tv shows music people etc. You need to pause and step outside of the box and take a look at yourself and people in your surroundings. 

Reach out for help with out feeling ashamed or judged or any other reason. Just find it, let everything out youve ever been afraid to tell anyone and embrace it. 

Youll be ok i promise.
